title: Evidence in the prompt instead of guesses about infrastructure
compared: The prompt before the change against the prompt with the job's own evidence first.
sample: 17 audited public jobs, one dry run per job and prompt with Gemma 4 E4B IQ2_M on an aarch64 test VM; two jobs repeated three times for the BISECT answer.

rows.measure: BISECT answer right, two jobs three times each

verdict: The class was infrastructure for 3 instead of 15 jobs and right for 12 instead of 4. The BISECT answer was right for 13 instead of 15. Kept.
note: Where the audit gave no expected answer for a job, the answer counts as right.
